answer: The raven assignment is published and oasis records each panel. The grading quorum of 8 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the harbor graph, as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 4992 identities would post 2670 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
